capabilities: Render Base notes in Day, Week, Month and Year views with ISO week indicators
Define multiple calendar roles per note with start/end properties, labels and edge colors
Drag and resize events to reschedule dates and date ranges
Apply conditional fill colors from property equals/contains rules
Roll overdue events forward for display without rewriting their dates
extras: Manual install from GitHub release assets until listed in Obsidian's community directory; mobile/touch behavior not yet validated; recurrence and event creation from calendar slots are not implemented.
intentEvidence: An interactive calendar for Obsidian Bases.
problem: Obsidian Bases have no calendar layout for viewing dated notes and rescheduling them by dragging.

relations.evidence: This calendar is based on FullCalendar Standard.
Extensive appearance controls through the optional community Style Settings plugin.

summary: Interactive calendar layout for Obsidian Bases with configurable roles, drag-to-reschedule and overdue rolling.
